question: On fixed splitting extensions, does the finite [2] fiber modulo sign realize the 2-by-2 quadratic function-field sandwich, while under-split, branch and inseparable controls reject the naive generic-fiber reading?

selection.field_modulus: first monic irreducible polynomial in the existing h116_field.rs coefficient ordering
selection.target: first affine P in x-index then y-index order such that Q=[2]P is affine, nonidentity and Q != -Q
selection.branch_target: first nonidentity T in the primary cell with [2]T=O

primary_measurements: curve point count and rational two-torsion kernel count
point-fiber sizes over Q and -Q and their union size
distinct source x-values in the union
minimum and maximum source x-lift multiplicities in the union
base-field, extension-field, point-addition and scalar-multiplication operation counts
primary_acceptance: the primary two-torsion kernel has four points
the Q and -Q point fibers each have four points and are disjoint
their union has eight points and four distinct x-values
every union x-value has two lifts and target x(Q) has two lifts
the counted balance coordinate_degree*source_x_degree = target_x_degree*curve_degree is 4*2=2*4
controls: over the base field, the canonical [2] point fiber has fewer than four points
for the first nonzero two-torsion target T, the +T/-T union has fewer than eight points and the target x-lift count is one
the distinct rational kernel of [p] in the primary extension has size strictly below p^2

execution.route: isolab EKS Spot after committed source gate; local execution is permitted only as an explicitly labelled development self-test before affected data

failure_policy: Retain every cell and control. Do not change extensions, target selection, acceptance thresholds or controls after observing affected counts.
claim_boundary: Finite rational-point fiber counts over three toy splitting extensions do not construct the function-field embeddings, prove reduced rational-function degree, establish scheme degree or separability, solve ECDLP, or imply subexponential runtime.
